summary: Light aircraft crash-landed around noon near Colo. 151 and Forest Service Road 613; pilot and passenger safely evacuated the wreckage, walked to a nearby residence and called for help; one transported for medical assistance (injury extent unknown at time of reporting)
location: Near Colo. 151 and Forest Service Road 613
responding_agency: Archuleta County Sheriff's Office; Southern Ute Police; Tribal Rangers
notes: ACSO dispatch 911 ~12:03 p.m. (pilot + passenger evacuated themselves); Southern Ute release ~12:45 p.m.; Southern Ute Indian Reservation vicinity. Filed per aviation precedent id 2400.
